notes: Three articles on שְׁלִישִׁית and the assimilated article before 'famine' go unrepresented, the ASV writing 'a third part' and 'with famine' (rules 12, 29).
The assimilated articles before 'pestilence' and 'sword' each take a written 'the'.
'will draw out' keeps the phrasal particle with the verb and heads on it (rule 44), as in v. 2.
